infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StrideSmart uses your GPS location to draw your live run path, calculate pace and distance, and generate loops from your starting point.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: StrideSmart needs background location access so your run continues tracking accurately when you lock your phone or listen to music.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: StrideSmart optionally reads your Heart Rate and Resting Heart Rate from Apple Health to display physiological insights on your post-run summary.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: StrideSmart writes your completed runs (distance, duration, active calories, and GPS route) to Apple Health so your Activity rings stay updated.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow StrideSmart to track your runs seamlessly even when your screen is locked.
